title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 25
paragraphs: After the sea-battle fought for Miletus, the Phoenicians, at the Persians' command, restored Aeaces son of Syloson to Samos, since he had been of great service to them and had done great things for them; and the Samians alone, of all who had revolted from Darius, had neither their city nor their temples burned, because of the desertion of their ships in the sea-fight. Then, after the capture of Miletus, the Persians at once got possession of Caria, some of the cities having submitted to their power voluntarily, while others they brought over by force.
